thread:
maria_support: FYI incoming escalation from a paying customer (SUP-9876). They say after yesterday's canary their assistant is dropping earlier instructions when session history gets long (>10k tokens). They sent a repro and logs. :warning:

maria_support: Customer snippet: "System: You are an accountant assistant. Remember user preferences: concise, bullet answers.
User: summarize Q1 results... (long history omitted)
Assistant: ...
User: now ask for tax breakdown
Assistant: ignores system role and answers verbose."

maria_support: Attached repro curl they ran (they're on Hosted API):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-neo-13b-v2","input":"[very long convo ~12k tokens]","max_output_tokens":256}'
```

maria_support: They included server-side headers from our responses: X-Redwood-Node: r04, X-Deploy-Tag: canary-2026-03-11, X-Cache-Hit: false

devon_engineer: Thanks, assigning to eng-runtime. Do we know which change in the canary could affect prefix/KV eviction? :eyes:

li_runtime: I checked canary changelog: we shipped a new dynamic_kv_prune heuristic that prunes old KV entries earlier when sequence length variance is high. It was meant to reduce memory pressure for long sessions.

ashley_ml: That would explain instruction loss — if the system prompt ends up evicted from KV cache, decoder won't see it. Any chance the customer was on a model variant that doesn't persist system prompt in prefix (we changed layout for v2)?

maria_support: Customer confirmed model was rwd-neo-13b-v2, rolled to canary yesterday (they didn't pin).

devon_engineer: Can we reproduce internally with synthetic history? I'll spin up a run with rwd-neo-13b-v2 and dynamic_kv_prune enabled.

traces-bot: New trace uploaded for SUP-9876: trace_id=tx_0a1b2c3d, spans show kv_cache.eviction at step ~512 tokens into response.

li_runtime: Looking at trace: eviction triggered when total active KV size > threshold and sequence variance spiked. The heuristic is too aggressive on long multi-turn chats.

devon_engineer: Repro steps I'm using (dev env):
1) seed system prompt "accountant assistant, concise, bullets"
2) append 40 user+assistant turns (~300 tokens each) to reach ~12k tokens
3) send followup asking to obey system prompt
4) observe that system directive is missing after response ~2

ashley_ml: Quick mitigation: set routing override to rwd-neo-13b-v1 (legacy KV semantics) for the customer's org until we fix. Also we can flip dynamic_kv_prune off in canary.

sanjay_product: Customer is on enterprise plan, SLA risk. Recommend immediate rollback on canary or opt-in pin for affected customers. Also notify CS to offer credits.

maria_support: I've told customer to pin model to rwd-neo-13b-v1 and to add explicit reminder in every user turn as a temporary workaround. They asked for ETA on fix.

devon_engineer: Priority: P1. I'll open an internal issue with reproducer and set a canary rollback flag. li_runtime can you prepare a patch to reduce prune aggressiveness and add a config gate?

li_runtime: On it. Patch will: reduce prune aggressiveness, add min-retention for system prompt KV entries, and emit a metric kv_prune_evictions{role=system}. I'll test in staging.

traces-bot: Alert created: kv_prune_evictions spike on canary-2026-03-11 cluster (r04).

maria_support: CS pinged and escalated SUP-9876 with suggested mitigation (pin + explicit reminders). They've accepted pinned model after guidance. :ok_hand:

devon_engineer: After patch I want to run A/B in canary: 50% traffic to new heuristic, 50% to patched. We'll monitor kv_prune_evictions, prefix_loss_rate, and customer regressions.

ashley_ml: Also add a quick eval harness: long-history unit that asserts system prompt survival after N turns. If it fails on canary we block rollout.

sanjay_product: Keep me posted. We should prepare a short customer-facing incident note explaining root cause (KV eviction heuristic) and timeline for fix.

maria_support: Filed SUP-9876 update noting rollback/pin options and ETA request. I'll update once devon/LI confirm patch deployed to canary-staging.

devon_engineer: Patch merged to canary-staging branch, running stress tests now. Will report back with numbers.

li_runtime: Stress test results: patched config drops evictions by ~92% on long-history reproducer. Pushing to canary with feature-flag off by default.

deploy-bot: deploy request created: canary-2026-03-12-patch-kv-prune, status: pending approval.

maria_support: Thanks team. CS will hold customer on pinned model until we flip the flag. Will close the loop when deploy completes. :heartbeat:
